name: Passthrough Color Studio & Night Vision
summary:
**Passthrough Color Studio** gives you direct, real-time control over your Meta Quest color passthrough image. Customize how you see your physical surroundings using color grading, low-light visual enhancement, and real-time edge outlines.

### Key Modes & Features:
* **Night Vision Mode:** Enhances visibility in dim environments using a custom phosphor-green 3D Color LUT.
